message: リ・クリエがもたらすもの

name: Ria
message: 「Good work, everyone~. Here, have some tea~」

name: Lolotte
message: 「How shameless of you, considering you didn't do a single thing.」

name: Ria
message: 「We need the chairwoman's seal right here, and it looks like we forgot to get it.」

name: Sally
message: 「Then I'll give it a big smooch mark instead~!」

name: Synn
message: 「I'll head over to Helena-san's place for a bit.」

name: Synn
message: 「Oh, you have a guest. Sorry to intrude...」

name: Helena
message: 「This is Sengen'in-sensei, who will be joining us as a student teacher starting next week.」

name: Synn
message: 「Ah, hello. I'm Synn Sakura, the President of the Ryuusei Student Council.」

name: Sengen'in
message: 「Well then, I'll be taking my leave.」

name: Helena
message: 「Yes, please do your best starting next week.」
She seemed like a rather intimidating teacher.
The sidelong glance she gave as she left involuntarily made me tense up.

name: Helena
message: 「Now then, what brings Synn-chan here today?」

name: Helena
message: 「--You wanted to see me... am I right?」

name: Synn
message: 「I came to get your stamp on some documents.」

name: Helena
message: 「Boo, boo! Synn-chan is being so cold!」

name: Helena
message: 「Now I'm sulking. I'm not going to stamp it for you anymore.」

name: Helena
message: 「That's your punishment for not playing along.」

name: Helena
message: 「Whoa, that's so mean! Hey, hey, Synn-chan, what do you think?」

name: Helena
message: 「Aah, even you, Synn-chan! You're all ganging up to bully me!」

name: Melilot
message: 「Helena. Please don't act like that when you know better.」

name: Helena
message: 「Having a serious talk with Sengen'in-sensei made me all tired out, after all.」

name: Melilot
message: 「I'm terribly sorry for having such a difficult-to-deal-with Chairwoman.」

name: Helena
message: 「Well then, since I have no choice, I'll get all tangled up wrestling with Melilot instead.」

name: Helena
message: 「Aaah, to think even Melilot would reject me...」

name: Helena
message: 「The only healing frontier left to me now is Ria's boobs...」

name: Helena
message: 「And so, I'm off to mess with the Student Council room for a bit!」

name: Melilot
message: 「The book I lent you previously is past its due date.」

name: Helena
message: 「Aah, that one. I've been too busy to find time to return it.」

name: Helena
message: 「It's sitting right over there, so go ahead and take it back yourself.」

name: Synn
message: 「If I go back now, it looks like it's going to be a real pain.」

name: Melilot
message: 「Then, I'll gladly take you up on your offer.」

name: Melilot
message: 「Sakura-kun, are you sure you're alright carrying so many?」

name: Synn
message: 「Yes. This much is nothing at all.」

name: Melilot
message: 「On second thought, how about we split them half and half?」

name: Synn
message: 「At least let me look cool at a time like this.」

name: Melilot
message: 「If you insist, Sakura-kun, then I'll leave it to you.」

name: Melilot
message: 「I suppose that's only to be expected of the Student Council President.」

name: Synn
message: 「How should I put it... what is it, I wonder.」

name: Synn
message: 「Regardless of stuff like that, it's more like I just want to... or something...」
Even I don't really know what I was trying to say.
I really can't manage to look cool, huh.
What was that sensation just now...?

name: Melilot
message: 「Yes. I've heard about them from Helena.」

name: Synn
message: 「This one is a type of Demon I've never seen before.」

name: Macaron
message: 「So I have to teach it a little lesson, you know.」

name: Macaron
message: 「Don't butt in, Big Brother. This is my job, after all.」

name: Macaron
message: 「Hey! I told you not to run away!」

name: Synn
message: 「Yes. What about you, Melilot-san, are you hurt at all?」

name: Melilot
message: 「Besides, even if something had happened, you would have protected me, wouldn't you, Sakura-kun?」

name: Melilot
message: 「Excuse me. It seems Helena has rubbed off on me.」

name: Melilot
message: 「For now, let's report what just happened to Helena later.」

name: Melilot
message: 「Now then, shall we hurry to the library?」
It's a good thing nothing happened this time, though...
The appearance of unprecedented demons must surely be due to the influence of Re-Crea.
Perhaps we should all get together once and come up with countermeasures.
